name: video1-motion-lab
description: Reusable whiteboard explainer scenes, kinetic captions, and smooth transition tests for CapCut overlays.

scripts.render:whiteboard: remotion render src/index.ts WhiteboardExplainer out/whiteboard-explainer.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.render:caption: remotion render src/index.ts KineticCaption out/kinetic-caption.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.render:transitions: remotion render src/index.ts TransitionShowcase out/transition-showcase.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && node --check scripts/render-svg.mjs && npm run test:icon-renderer
scripts.render:caption:alpha: remotion render src/index.ts KineticCaption out/kinetic-caption-alpha.mov --codec prores --prores-profile 4444 --pixel-format yuva444p10le --image-format png
